settings.editor: Ready to advance your career with a high-tech manufacturer? Goodfellow Microfabrication is always looking for detail-oriented, multitasking professionals to join the team in Maryland, whether your experience is in shipping and receiving, operations or another area.
We offer competitive pay and a comprehensive benefits package. If there is no role listed that matches your experience, we still welcome your résumé for future opportunities.

• Competitive pay
  • 401(k) with matching
  • Health, dental and vision insurance
  • Life insurance
  • Paid time off
